title: SOC Home Lab - Overview
description: Dashboard build specification. Create the panels in Splunk Dashboard Studio or Classic Dashboard and adapt indexes/fields to your lab.

panels.title: Failed Logons Over Time
panels.purpose: Trend Windows Event ID 4625 over time
panels.search: index=wineventlog (EventCode=4625 OR EventID=4625) | timechart span=5m count

panels.title: Top Failed Logon Sources
panels.purpose: Prioritize repeated failures by source and target account
panels.search: index=wineventlog (EventCode=4625 OR EventID=4625) | eval source_ip=coalesce(IpAddress,Source_Network_Address,src_ip,src) | eval target_user=coalesce(TargetUserName,user,Account_Name) | stats count by source_ip target_user | sort - count | head 10

panels.title: Sysmon Process Events
panels.purpose: Recent process creation activity for triage
panels.search: index=endpoint sourcetype=*Sysmon* (EventCode=1 OR EventID=1) | table _time host User Image CommandLine ParentImage | sort - _time

panels.title: Network Port Fan-out
panels.purpose: Highlight sources touching many destination ports when network data is configured
panels.search: index=network | eval source_ip=coalesce(src_ip,src,id_orig_h,SourceAddress) | eval destination_port=coalesce(dest_port,dst_port,id_resp_p,DestinationPort) | where isnotnull(source_ip) AND isnotnull(destination_port) | stats dc(destination_port) as unique_ports count as connections by source_ip | sort - unique_ports

notes: This JSON is a panel specification, not a guaranteed importable dashboard definition.
Update indexes, sourcetypes, and field names to match your Splunk environment.
Use a shared time picker and test each panel before publishing.
